messages:
alex: hitting 500s on inference-router in prod, trying to push a tiny config hotfix. need prod deploy perms, i don't have deployer role. can someone assist?

deploy-bot: Automated check: deploy to `prod` requires `deployer` role + MFA on account. Request a temporary elevation via IAM JIT or have an authorized deployer run the job. See https://go/redwood/deploy-perms

ops-oncall: @alex can you share the runbook link and PR? if it's low risk I can take it but i'm on a paging window.

alex: PR: https://git.redwood.com/r/inference/routers/pull/342
small config change, docker tag `infer-2.3.7-hotfix`.

kevin: if ops-oncall is busy, @sasha can you do the deploy? you're release lead today.

sasha: I don't have direct prod deploy perms either (just can approve rollouts). we need to either grant 20m JIT to alex OR do a cross-team handoff. prefer handoff if oncall can run.

jenna: ops-oncall, if you take it pls run canary first: `rdeploy canary --service=inference-router --image=infer-2.3.7-hotfix` and monitor 2xx/500 for 5m.

ops-oncall: can't right now, paging + incident. I can approve a temporary JIT for alex via identity portal if security ok with 30m window.

maria: security note: JIT must be recorded in audit and require MFA before elevation. also annotate why in the request so we can tracked. we should avoid ad-hoc long-lived role grants.

alex: happy with 30m JIT + MFA. will run canary and follow rollback if errors. thanks.

sasha: OK ops-oncall, can you create the JIT and cc `release-approvals`? i'll do the final prod push once alex confirms canary good.

ops-oncall: created JIT (30m) for alex. audit id `audit-20260304-89ab`. alex: please confirm MFA and start canary.

alex: MFA done. running canary now.

alex: canary looks clean after 6m. error rate back to baseline.

sasha: proceeding to prod deploy in 2m. tagging release notes: "router config: increase upstream timeout to 3s; hotfix for intermittent 500"

sasha: prod deploy done. monitoring 10m.

maria: noticed the JIT prompt didn't include runbook link; filing a small follow-up to IAM playbook to require runbook URL in future requests. filed: IAM-1224.

kevin: nice, let's add a checklist step in release docs to prefer cross-team handoff if oncall constrained.

alex: thanks team :heart:
